title: AI Systems Engineering 技术雷达（高信号版）

signals.title: Agent capability discovery is becoming a runtime control-plane concern
signals.summary: Microsoft Agentic Resource Discovery and GitHub Copilot Agent Finder are treated as a signal that agents need governed runtime discovery for MCP servers, skills, agents, tools, registries, invocation boundaries, and policy metadata instead of relying only on static tool configuration.

signals.title: Durable execution, sandboxing, and filesystem state are becoming agent runtime primitives
signals.summary: Cloudflare's Agents SDK and Flue integration frame production agents as recoverable distributed systems with Durable Objects, durable streams, dynamic code execution, durable virtual filesystems, workflow steps, and credential-safe bindings rather than one-shot request handlers.

signals.title: Agent evaluation is moving toward production trajectory replay
signals.summary: OpenAI Deployment Simulation is captured as a signal that model and agent releases need historical conversation and coding-trajectory replay, tool-response simulation, environment realism checks, and comparison against likely deployment behavior rather than only static benchmark scores.

signals.title: Agent security is shifting from static permissions to monitored reasoning, plans, and actions
signals.summary: Google DeepMind's AI Control Roadmap treats internal AI agents as possible insider threats and emphasizes defense-in-depth with trusted supervisors, action blocking, protocol escalation, and metrics for coverage, recall, and response time over coding-agent tasks.

signals.title: Security agents are being organized as multi-stage, recoverable harnesses
signals.summary: Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness is treated as a strong systems signal because it separates recon, hunt, validation, reporting, independent re-verification, persisted run state, context control, model routing, retry, resume, and finding ingestion instead of depending on a single security-review prompt.

ideas.title: Agent Trajectory Ledger
ideas.summary: Build a small ledger that records each agent step with capability source, authority scope, risk level, checkpoint state, tool response, status, and replay-candidate markers so agent workflows gain minimal observability, recovery, supervision, and evaluation hooks.
